claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_trait UnitRecord kind + species_trait_root source atom
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no species_trait variant. The v4 taxonomy lists species_trait_root as a source atom, but types.ts only exposes spell, class_feature, and mastery. No honest encoding is possible until this kind is added.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Giant Ancestry is a species trait. The type union `SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord` has no branch for species_trait.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: open_choice (choose-one-of-N at character creation)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Giant Ancestry presents six mutually exclusive sub-options from which the player picks one permanently. No surface family models this choose-one-of-N selection at character creation. The v4 `choose` procedure atom exists but there is no authored shape for it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.proficiency_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature's use count equals the character's Proficiency Bonus, which scales with character level on a fixed schedule. The current UseCountCap variants (fixed, threshold_tiers) cannot express PB-scaling directly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus

claude_proposed_widenings.name: teleport (self-movement to unoccupied seen space)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Cloud's Jaunt teleports the user up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. This is a movement effect distinct from force_move, move, or transport_exile. No current effect atom covers voluntary self-teleportation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed (temporary speed reduction on target)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Frost's Chill reduces the target's Speed by 10 feet until the start of the attacker's next turn. modify_speed exists in the v4 taxonomy but is not surfaced in any current effect type in types.ts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken (damage mitigation via reaction roll)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Stone's Endurance lets the user roll 1d12 + CON modifier and subtract that total from incoming damage. This is reduce_damage_taken, a known residue atom in v4 taxonomy (§12 Known Remaining Weak Spots) that was explicitly not promoted. Single-group pressure here.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_taken_reaction (retaliatory reaction that deals damage to the attacker)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Storm's Thunder fires when the user takes damage from a creature within 60 feet, dealing 1d8 Thunder back to that creature as a Reaction. This is a retaliatory damage reaction not modeled by any existing window/resolution/effect chain in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.
